# Spells List
Summons a grasp-like spell focus to your hand. It needs blood to cast spells, feed it from a living being's blood.
It can also be used to heal cultists by hitting them.
Can be used on some objects like airlocks and plasteel, turning them into cult versions.
[bold]This is how you get [color=#dc143c]runed metal[/color]![/bold]
[bold]It can also transmute cyborgs into constructs![/bold]
Cuffs and mutes a victim with ethereal [bold]shadow shackles[/bold], which disintegrate if removed so they can't be used against you.
Stuns and mutes the target, giving you plenty of time to kidnap them and bring them to your cult's lair.
Can be cast on yourself or a fellow cultist, teleporting them to a teleport rune of your choice after a few seconds.
Creates a 20 second EMP instantly, taking out sec's batongs and such.
Gives you armored cult robes, a cult bola and a longsword. The sword can't be used in rituals, it's just a good weapon.
Gives you another ritual dagger incase you lost the one you spawned with.
